visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, bangs, and a pink dress stands outdoors in front of a street food stall. She holds a large transparent plastic bag filled with golden-brown crispy rice snacks. The background shows a red stall banner with Thai text, overhead power lines, and blurred street activity. (2) The camera transitions to a medium close-up of the woman's face. She uses her fingers to pick a small piece of the rice snack and puts it in her mouth, chewing and looking directly at the camera with a neutral expression. (3) The visual cuts to a man in a red t-shirt and white gloves at the stall. He pours a thick, dark brown syrup from a plastic container onto a large pile of crispy rice cakes sitting in a wide metal tray. (4) A close-up shot shows the man's hands using a wooden ladle and metal tongs to mix the syrup-covered rice cakes. The texture of the food is sticky and glossy. (5) A hand reaches into a plastic bag to retrieve a single syrup-coated rice cracker. The cracker is irregular in shape and covered in small grains. (6) The final phase shows a group shot where the woman in the pink dress is joined by three stall workers, two men and one woman, all wearing red shirts. They pose together, smiling and making peace signs, while the woman holds the large bag of snacks.
